## Sea Swirl — G4 *Friendship Is Magic*

[![Sea Swirl, a lilac unicorn with a blue mane and dolphin cutie mark](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/941d6e5b-db38-48de-a4ef-86f50994a618/d7ubwlp-660bf963-1afe-4866-a9df-846e42812641.png?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Vj2_JZwiVTuxo31sZ57ffwgpmOiUd9jVYH2uI3LemR0)](https://www.deviantart.com/bluemeganium/art/Sea-Swirl-as-seen-in-Leap-of-Faith-474207181)

*Portrait vector by bluemeganium (2014), based on the show's design.*

Sea Swirl is the lilac-pink unicorn with a two-tone blue mane, rose eyes, and two circling dolphins for a cutie mark. A familiar Ponyville background mare, she often appears near Sassaflash; she is a unicorn, not a seapony. Her first appearance is at Twilight's surprise party in *Friendship Is Magic, Part 1* (S1E1). She also turns up at *Winter Wrap Up*, Nightmare Night, weddings, and the bowling alley. The [background-pony retrospective](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2016/02/pony-spotlight-6-sea-swirl.html) recounts her recurring appearances.

*Name and continuity:* “Sea Swirl” is a Hasbro merchandise name, appearing on a [2012 Wave 3 blind-bag figure](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bags/details/3w10/) and [collector cards](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bag-cards/pony/sea-swirl/) that describe her love of swimming. The television dialogue never addresses her by name. *Seafoam/Sea Foam* and *Dolphin Dream* are fandom nicknames, not secret identities or separate official characters.

*Speaking:* She is *not mute*: in *The Cutie Pox* she exclaims “Cool! A bowling cutie mark!” and later reacts “Cutie pox?!”; in *Buckball Season* she cries out during tryouts. [IMDb's episode credits](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2071866/fullcredits/) list Ashleigh Ball as Sea Swirl's English voice for *The Cutie Pox*. She has no sustained speaking storyline.

## Important moments

- *Her first spoken line — “The Cutie Pox” (S2E6).* She congratulates a colt on earning a bowling cutie mark, sharpening Apple Bloom's disappointment. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHoOy5TSByI) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- *Helping the pet fundraiser — “Filli Vanilli” (S4E14).* She appears at the Ponyville Pet Center fundraiser, a small but tangible show of community participation. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dIpzm3vt-bE) (timestamp unavailable).
- *Tempted by a miracle cure — “Leap of Faith” (S4E20).* Wearing a neck support, she lines up for Flim and Flam's misleading tonic, showing the scheme's appeal to ordinary ponies. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JU1GNrisN_w) (timestamp unavailable).
- *Buckball hopeful — “Buckball Season” (S6E18).* She tries out as a unicorn player and yelps when the ball approaches; it is a rare sporting scene focused on her rather than a simple crowd cameo. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JbIx2afSePc) (timestamp unavailable).

*A show still:* [Sea Swirl among the ponies in “The Cutie Pox”](https://twibooru.org/128122) (screen capture from Hasbro/DHX's production; archived on Twibooru).
